chapter.v:
The following
is the genealogy of Esau (also known as Edom).

Esau married
two Canaanite women: Adah, daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite.

In addition
he married Basemath, daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

Adah had
a son for Esau named Eliphaz. Basemath had Reul.

Oholibamah had
Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in Canaan.

Esau took
his wives, sons and daughters, and everyone in his household, together with his livestock, all his other animals, and all the possessions he had gained while in Canaan, and went to live in a country far away from his brother Jacob.

He did
this because the land they were living in couldn't support both of them with all their livestock.

Esau settled
down in the hill country of Seir.

The following
is the genealogy of Esau, father of the Edomites, who lived in the hill country of Seir:

These were
the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, son of Esau's wife Adah, and Reuel, son of Esau's wife Basemath.

The sons
of Eliphaz were: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

Timna, the
concubine of Esau's son Eliphaz, had Amalek for Eliphaz. These were the descendants of Esau's wife Adah.

These were
the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They were the descendants of Esau's wife Basemath.

These were
the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah, daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, whom she had for Esau: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

These were
the tribal leaders of Esau's sons. The tribal leaders of the sons of Eliphaz (Esau's firstborn) were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

Korah, Gatam,
and Amalek. They were the tribal leaders of Eliphaz in the country of Edom, and they were the descendants of Adah.

These were
the sons of Esau's son Reuel: tribal leaders Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They were the tribal leaders descended from Reuel in the country of Edom, and they were the descendants of Esau's wife Basemath.

These were
the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah: tribal leaders Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. They were the tribal leaders descended from Esau's wife Oholibamah, daughter of Anah.

All these
were the sons of Esau (also called Edom), and they were their tribal leaders.

These were
the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the country: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

Dishon, Ezer,
and Dishan. They were the tribal leaders of the Horites, the descendants of Seir in the land of Edom.

The sons
of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Timna was Lotan's sister.

These were
the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

These were
the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. (This was the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the desert while he was looking after the donkeys of his father Zibeon.)

These were
the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, daughter of Anah.

These were
the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

These were
the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

These were
the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

These were
the tribal leaders of the Horites: tribal leaders Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

Dishon, Ezer,
and Dishan. They were the tribal leaders of the Horites listed according to their tribes in the country of Seir.

These were
the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before there was any king who ruled over the Israelites:

Bela, son
of Beor, ruled in Edom and the name of his town was Dinhabah.

When Bela
died, Jobab, son of Zerah from Bozrah, took over as king.

When Jobab
died, Husham from the land of the Temanites took over as king.

When Husham
died, Hadad, son of Bedad, took over as king. He was the one who defeated the Midianites in the country of Moab, and the name of his town was Avith.

When Hadad
died, Samlah from Masrekah took over as king.

When Samlah
died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates took over as king.

When Shaul
died, Baal-hanan, son of Achbor, took over as king.

When Baal-hanan,
son of Achbor, died, Hadad took over as king. The name of his town was Pau, and his wife's name was Mehetabel, daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-zahab.

These were
the names of the tribal leaders descended from Esau, according to their families and where they lived, listed by name: tribal leaders Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

Magdiel, and
Iram. These were the tribal leaders of Edom, listed according to the places where they lived in the country. Esau was the ancestor of the Edomites.
